chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim raised it (as marfu') to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The seekers of knowledge are three — recognize them by their persons and their descriptions: a type who seeks it for ignorance and disputation, a type who seeks it for domination and deception, and a type who seeks it for understanding and intellect.

The one seeking it for ignorance and disputation is harmful and argumentative, exposing himself to speech in the assemblies of men by discussing knowledge while claiming the attribute of forbearance; he has clothed himself in humility while stripping himself of piety. May God crush his nose and cut off his chest.

The one seeking it for domination and deception is possessed of cunning and flattery — he dominates over those who resemble him, yet humbles himself before the wealthy beneath him. So he devours their worldly sweets while destroying his religion. May God blind his reputation and cut off his trace from the legacies of the scholars.

The one seeking it for understanding and intellect is possessed of grief, sorrow, and sleepless vigils — he has wrapped his cloak and stands the night in its darkness; he works and fears, trembling, supplicating, compassionate, attentive to his affairs, knowing the people of his time, wary even of his most trusted brethren. So may God strengthen his foundations and grant him security on the Day of Resurrection.

And it was narrated to me by Muhammad ibn Mahmud Abu Abdillah al-Qazwini, from a number of our companions, among them Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sayqal in Qazwin, from Ahmad ibn Isa al-Alawi, from Abbad ibn Suhayb al-Basri, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him).

key_terms.الِاسْتِطَالَة: Istitalah — seeking dominance or superiority over others through knowledge
key_terms.الْحِنْدِس: Hindis — pitch darkness, used poetically for the dark of night
key_terms.الْخَتْل: Khatal — guile, deception, seeking to manipulate others
key_terms.الْمِرَاء: Miraa' — contentious disputation, arguing for the sake of winning rather than truth
key_terms.الْوَرَع: Wara' — scrupulous piety, abstaining even from permissible things out of caution
key_terms.حَيْزُومَهُ: Hayzum — the chest and heart, site of intention; cutting it off means removing all motivation

ai.seo_question: What are the three types of knowledge seekers according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) classifies all knowledge-seekers into three types based on their true intention: those driven by arrogance and love of debate (condemned), those driven by social climbing and manipulation (condemned), and those driven by genuine understanding and God-consciousness (praised). This typology was directed to students of religious learning in 8th-century Kufa and Medina, where scholarship had become intertwined with social prestige and court politics. The Imam's vivid characterizations — from the hypocritical debater clothed in false humility, to the genuinely devout scholar who distrusts even his closest companions — taught disciples to examine their own motivations for seeking knowledge.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, 
(It has been narrated) raising it to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘

The seekers of knowledge are three, so recognise them by their personalities and their description. There is a type who seeks it (to overcome) the ignorance and the disputes, and there is a type who seeks it for the domination and the deception, and there is a type who seeks it for the understanding and the intelligence.

So the one (seeking it for) the ignorance and the disputes is harmful, argumentative of the speech in the presence of the men by the discussion of the knowledge, and he would be described as forbearing by the one who has adorned with the humbleness, but he is devoid of the piety. May Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Hammer his nose (Condemn him) and cut off his heart and chest (Humiliate him).

And the one seeking is for the domination and the deception is with the swindle and enticement. He would dominate upon the likes of him who resemble him, and he would be revering to the rich ones from besides him. Thus, he would be digesting their sweets and breaking down his Religion. May Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blind upon this of his news and Cut off the traces of such scholars of his traces.

And the one (seeking it for) the understanding and ‘الْعَقْلِ’ the intelligence is with the heartaches, and the grief, and the vigils, and would have covered his head in his robe, and stands (to pray) the night (Salat) in his dark nights. He works hard, and he is fearful, apprehensive, supplicating, being compassionate, attentive upon his affairs, recognising the people of his time, scared of even the ones trustworthy of his brethren. So may Allahazwj Intensify Hisazwj Pillars from this one, and Give him security on the Day of Judgment’.

And it was narrated to me by Muhammad Bin Mahmoun Abu Abdullah Al Qazwiny, from a number of our companions, among them being Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Sayqal, at Qazweek, from Ahmad Bin Isa, Al Alawy, from Abbad Bin Suheyb Al Basry, from Abu Abdullahasws.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim in a marfu’ manner has narrated from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following.

“The seekers of knowledge are of three kinds. The more noticeable of them in person or character are: (a) the group who seeks knowledge for ignorance and quarrel. (b) The group who seeks knowledge to dominate and cheat others. (c) The group who seeks knowledge for proper understanding, Fiqh, and power of intelligence.

The group whose purpose of seeking knowledge is ignorance and quarrel is a harmful and quarrelsome group. This group interrupts conversations in the gatherings of the people to speak about knowledge and the description of forbearance. Such people appear in the garb of the gentle and humble ones but, in fact, are devoid of all the qualities of the pious people. Allah has humiliated and has condemned this group.

The group that seeks domination and cheating is a deceitful and flattering group. Such people try to dominate people of their kind and flatter the wealthy ones who know less than they do. Such people consume the sweetmeat of the rich people and destroy their own religion. May Allah banish the news of such people and cut off their traces from the history of the scholars.

“The group that seeks knowledge for the sake of Fiqh, proper understanding, and to gain the power of intelligence consists of people who are deeply concerned and stay awake very often. They pull their robe on their heads and standup for prayer in the darkness of nights. They work hard anxiously and fearfully and pray with deep worries. They are very attentive of their affairs, knowledgeable of the people of their time and fearful even of their own trusted brothers. May Allah strengthen the corners of such people and grant them salvation on the Day of Judgment.”

Narrated to me the above hadith Muhammad ibn Mahmud abu ‘Abdallah al-Qazwini from a number of our people of whom is Ja‘far in Muhammad al-Sayqal of Qazwin from Ahmad ibn ‘Isa al-‘Alawi from ‘Abbad ibn Suhayb al-Basri from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.).
